content.name: UN-supervised plebiscite in the British Cameroons

attributes.summary: In a UN-supervised plebiscite, the southern part chose to join the former French Cameroun, while the northern part voted to join the Federation of Nigeria.

content.name: Reunification and the Federal Republic of Cameroon

attributes.summary: Southern Cameroons joined the Republic of Cameroon to form the Federal Republic of Cameroon, made up of two federated states: East Cameroon (capital Yaoundé) and West Cameroon (capital Buea).
